stem.text: A balance is used to measure the mass $m$ of a number of cylindrical metal rods of length $l$. All the metal rods have the same radius $r$.
The graph shows the variation with $l$ of $m$.

stem.alt: Graph with the vertical axis labelled m and the horizontal axis labelled l, both starting from 0, with a straight line through the origin.

stem.text: The gradient of the graph is $G$.
Which expression gives the density of the metal?
